interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue

preconditions.name: variance_tracking_bar_in_force_somewhere
preconditions.description: BEST cell's fraction of measured SELECT CALLS with a non-None variance_tracking_commit_bar. This is the SAME statistic the P1_FEASIBLE criterion routes on. If the bar engages NOWHERE on the whole ladder, the instrument never ran and no env verdict is licensed -- that is substrate_not_ready, not infeasibility.
preconditions.control: the softest rungs are the positive control: their episodes are longest, so if the window cannot fill there it cannot fill anywhere

preconditions.name: commit_gate_window_filled_in_some_cell
preconditions.description: cells whose warm prefix reached the full 200-select-call window. Separates 'the bar cannot engage' from 'the warm-up was too short' -- the conflation that made the predecessor probe unreadable.
preconditions.control: warm-up runs to WARM_EPISODE_CAP=200 episodes or a full window

preconditions.name: training_collapsed_running_variance
preconditions.description: worst cell's log10 collapse of running_variance across training. The whole premise is a TRAINED world-forward model; an untrained one sits at precision_init and the window goes degenerate (V3-EXQ-925a).
preconditions.control: rv at agent construction vs rv after P0+P1

preconditions.name: training_tick_budget_equalised
preconditions.description: max/min REALISED total training ticks across rungs. Episode counts are derived per rung to equalise ticks, because `_train_all_on_agent` breaks on `done` and a fixed episode budget would hand the short-episode rungs ~5x less training along exactly the manipulated dimension -- corrupting both the rv-dispersion deliverable and the worst-cell readiness gate below. UPPER bound: a LARGE ratio is the failure.

preconditions.name: all_rungs_tick_budgetable
preconditions.description: rungs whose tick budget could NOT be met within MAX_TRAIN_EPISODES_PER_PHASE and were therefore dropped. GATED, and that is the point: the drop can only ever remove a SHORT-episode rung (the budget is ceil(target/length), so only a small length overruns the cap), which is the ladder's MINIMUM and also the lineage control. On 1070's own measured rung means, dropping L0 moves D1's episode-length range from 3.32 to 1.94 -- i.e. a budget failure would present as 'the ladder did not sweep'. Gating here keeps that mis-attribution impossible: a drop routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue, which is what it is.
preconditions.control: per-(rung, seed) pilot budget vs MAX_TRAIN_EPISODES_PER_PHASE

preconditions.name: driver_never_writes_running_variance
preconditions.description: the V3-EXQ-063a defect, as a source-level assert.
preconditions.control: AST walk over this file's assignment targets

interpretation.routes_to: NO env verdict is licensed; failed precondition(s): training_tick_budget_equalised. Do NOT read any of this as ARC-029 infeasibility.
